summary: Both blocking findings are valid and should be repaired in spec.json. The non-blocking install --json help suggestion is advisory memory only.

items.title: Define the upgrade invocation boundary
items.rationale: The current spec permits an unsafe in-process upgrade call. The spec must require a captured normal upgrade entrypoint or equivalent adapter so process.exit and stdout/stderr behavior cannot bypass plugin output.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[0] explains that src/upgrade.js failure paths can call process.exit and contaminate --json if invoked in-process.

items.title: Preserve config.local plugin overlay behavior
items.rationale: The current spec does not preserve the existing private overlay path. The spec must require automatic-upgrade metadata and decision logic to respect merged config without writing overlay-only source/package data to public config.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[1] identifies existing installPlugin config.local overlay behavior and the risk of leaking private source data into .senti/config.json.
